reference.reference_fasta: GRCh38_chr9.fa.gz (chromosome 9 from the Broad Institute GATK GRCh38 bundle)

gene_lof_constraint_prior.source: gnomAD v2.1.1 loss-of-function constraint metrics (Karczewski et al., Nature 2020); approximate published values, used as external prior knowledge for gene-level interpretation only

STXBP1.note: highly LoF-intolerant; haploinsufficiency causes STXBP1 developmental & epileptic encephalopathy (OMIM 612164)

GRIN3A.note: constrained, but the candidate AF (~0.55) is in the germline-heterozygous range, not mosaic

ENG.note: haploinsufficient (HHT1), but the candidate alt reads co-occur with other candidate alleles (mismapping)

ALAD.note: recessive (porphyria); not LoF-intolerant; candidate shows strong strand bias

COL27A1.note: not highly LoF-intolerant; candidate supported by only 4 single-strand reads

FAM78A.note: not LoF-intolerant; region is a dense cluster of co-occurring candidate alleles (paralog decoy)
